definitions.explanation: Describes interactions, services, or transactions conducted without meeting in person. Became widespread during the COVID-19 pandemic and remains common in business and service contexts.

examples.japanese: {非対面|ひたいめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{取|と}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
{非対面|ひたいめん}{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Non-face-to-face sales styles are on the rise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、{非対面|ひたいめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いして→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: As an infection control measure, we ask that you complete procedures without face-to-face contact.

notes:
USAGE:
{非対面|ひたいめん} is used as a noun modifier (often with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or in compound form) to describe services, transactions, or interactions conducted remotely or without direct personal contact.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非対面|ひたいめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (remote support)
- {非対面|ひたいめん}{型|がた}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (contactless service)
- {非対面|ひたいめん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (non-face-to-face sales)

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧ (face-to-face, in-person). Both are common in business and administrative contexts.
